g.text: A 3rd year BS Information Technology student who loves turning
ideas into simple and useful websites. Currently learning more
about front-end development and UI/UX design.
Hello! I'm Ivan Angelo T. Mortel, a 3rd year Bachelor of Science in
Information Technology student. I got into IT because I was always
curious about how websites and apps work, and now I get to build my
Most of my experience comes from school projects where I worked on
both the front-end and the database side. I like designing my layouts
in Figma first before coding them, which is actually how I made this
portfolio. Right now I'm improving my JavaScript skills and learning
PHP and MySQL more deeply so I can build complete web systems.
When I'm not coding, I'm usually watching tech videos, playing games
with friends, or trying out new UI ideas.
